Run the Line 1 achievement transitions sub-analysis

Source: R/01_trend_transitions.R
run_achievement_transitions.Rd

Computes transition matrices, flags normatively large transitions, compares results to scale score and proficiency trends, and produces plots and narrative text.

Usage

run_achievement_transitions(
  student_results_long,
  assessment_spec,
  score_trends,
  proficiency,
  min_n = 10,
  flag_sd = 1.5
)

Arguments

student_results_long

A long-format student results data frame.

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

score_trends

Named list returned by run_score_trends().

proficiency

Named list returned by run_proficiency().

min_n

Integer. Minimum cell size for suppression. Default 10.

flag_sd

Numeric. SD threshold for normative flagging. Default 1.5.

Value

A named list:

  • $matrices — transition data and plots

  • $flags — normative flag table, plot, and narrative

  • $comparisons — correlations, divergence flags, and scatter plots

  • $text — overall narrative
